what: A validator gained a second bound check on a file that already had one mutant covering it, and the new comparison went completely untested, because coverage was only ever tracked once per file, never once per line. A file-level coverage count reads as satisfied the moment any one comparison on that file has a mutant, even while a second, unrelated comparison added later has none at all.
rule: A mutant is required for every pass-bar comparison a change adds, not just once per file that comparison happens to live in.
fix: Enforcement: mutation testing now also warns, at the line level, when a new or changed comparison operator has no mutant whose own target text actually touches that exact line, layered over the existing file-level warning rather than replacing it. Regression coverage is in `tests/field-lessons-batch-w.test.mjs`.
